prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable two-contender team avatar for the ARC Daily Digest's ARC2 nvbanana profile. Reference1 is Jean-François Puget's own single-person Hall-of-Fame cyber-engineer character. Preserve his swept dark-brown hair, strong brown beard, blue-green eyes, stern-friendly face, cyan-lit helmet and dense signature shoulder GPU armor. Discard ALL printed words, rank/score/team labels, logos and framing from reference1. Reference2 is Darragh Hanley's actual owner-selected Kaggle avatar: a painterly cobalt-and-gold swirling starry sky. It is NOT his human face. Depict Hanley's account as an ORIGINAL fictional adult-proportioned celestial contender, with a fully opaque midnight-blue helmet whose faceplate is a beautiful swirling golden-cobalt galaxy with no human facial features, blue-gold ARC racer armor and a short star-patterned scarf. Exactly TWO separate compact adult-proportioned full-body figures standing side by side as a formidable friendly esports duo on a luminous ARC puzzle-grid floor in a grand soft-focus scoring hall. Puget on left in his recognizable cyan cyber-engineer gear, one hand on waist and other open in confident greeting; cosmic Hanley avatar on right holds one small floating multicolor square ARC tile. Their gear has saturated red green cyan yellow blue magenta orange white and black square puzzle patches. NVIDIA-green accent lights as editorial fantasy, no company logos or literal spending/hardware claims. A subtle small curved golden banana-shaped ornament stands on the podium edge, playful nod to team name, no extra character. Warm amber arena rimlights, cool blue fill, very polished detailed cinematic 3D comic style. Preserve subject separation, all boots and hands inside frame. No third figure, no person hidden behind them, no words, letters, labels, numerals, medals, ranks, scores, logos or watermark. The right-hand celestial figure is explicitly an account-avatar adaptation and never a claimed likeness of Hanley.
